This chain of targets culminates in G-protein coupled receptor 81, indicating a potential pathway where vorinostat may modulate the activity of this receptor through its interaction with Trichostatin A. The evidence implies that vorinostat could influence G-protein coupled receptor 81 via a mechanism involving Trichostatin A, possibly by altering the expression or function of the intermediate target. The integration of these pathways highlights the role of Trichostatin A as a bridge between vorinostat and the receptor, suggesting a possible regulatory role in cellular signaling.
